evidence_table.claim: Q3 revenue was USD909m, with Software & Services USD437.030m and Connected Devices USD471.524m.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Q3 shareholder-letter consolidated and segment tables; 437.030 / 908.554 = 48.10% software mix.

evidence_table.claim: Software revenue grew 43%, ARR was USD1.750bn, NRR was 126%, and future contracted bookings were USD15.8bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Shareholder-letter operating metrics; ARR, NRR and bookings are kept distinct from recognised revenue.
evidence_table.result: verified; company-defined measures and fulfilment caveats retained

evidence_table.claim: Software gross margin was 71.4% versus 73.8%, device margin 43.0% versus 49.9%, and total margin 56.7% versus 60.1%.
Axon removed about USD130m of expected 2026 federal Dedrone revenue and guided Q4 to USD990m-USD1.01bn and the year to about USD3.61bn-USD3.63bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Outlook section; USD30m delayed from Q3 plus USD100m from Q4.
evidence_table.result: verified and labelled as management guidance

evidence_table.claim: The additional Skydio investment is USD1.2bn in cash and Axon shares, adds about 20 percentage points of fully diluted ownership at a USD5.2bn pre-money valuation and would lift the stake to about 37%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Skydio transaction announcement; closing conditions and Q4 2026/Q1 2027 timing retained.
evidence_table.result: verified as expected transaction terms, not completed investment

evidence_table.claim: Operating cash flow was USD20m, non-GAAP free cash flow was negative USD19m, and strategic inventory used about USD100m of cash.
